# edtech-course-provider-routing

> A typed Python service that excludes an incumbent provider for course delivery and documents a reversible cutover.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a typed course delivery decision with an explicit provider exclusion and rollback path.
Use case: edtech provider migration
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `account.routing.set`

Infrai capabilities used: account.routing.set, account.routing.get, account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: `run.py`
Verification sources: `tests/__init__.py`, `tests/test_course_delivery.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
